dogecoin.text: @RobinhoodApp announced that 60% of its customers traded crypto in the last quarter, and crypto revenue added up to 41% of its total revenue. In that crypto revenue, 62% came from Dogecoin. They also plan to add more coins and tokens & a wallet.
While we’re here, more news on Doge. @Dogecoin Foundation announced new members to its advisory board: @Ethereum co-founder @VitalikButerin and @elonmusk representative Jared Birchall.
@elonmusk jumps to the conversation and tweets, “I’ve been saying this for a while.” Result? Dogecoin jumped %8 last week, making it a jump of %66 in the last month.

After @MCuban announced Mavericks merchandise bought using @Dogecoin will enjoy a ‘special pricing,’ he said in an interview that, “the community for doge is the strongest when it comes to using it as a medium of exchange.”
Tennis champion Naomi Osaka is thinking of investing in cryptocurrencies, as @dogecoin got her interest. She already has a series of #NFTs on DraftKings Marketplace and https://t.co/Yip6q8JFyI.
@elonmusk got a new dog, a Shiba Inu named #Floki, thus causing Floki-themed cryptocurrencies to soar. https://t.co/rlE3o37VHl
@Shibtoken Inu surged in value up 45%, making its market cap greater than @dogecoin's, putting Shiba in 9th spot on @coingecko's list.
